title: The hospices in the hospice case: who owns them, since when, and what else those owners run
question: Do the fast-growing East Bay hospices share owners, addresses or managers, and did their owners change after certification?
finding: 6 of the 6 hospices named in the case are in the federal owner files. For 3 of them every present owner arrived after Medicare certification: A Plus Prime Care Hospice Inc (certified 2021-12-11, present owners from 2022-10-01, 9 months later; $8.8 million in 2024); Home Connect Hospice, LLC. (trading as Valor Hospice) (certified 2022-02-09, present owners from 2023-09-01, 18 months later; $4.0 million in 2024); Seasons Hospice & Palliative Care Of California -Oakland LLC (trading as Accentcare Hospice & Palliative Care Of California - Oakland) (certified 2019-01-27, present owners from 2020-12-21, 22 months later; $2.4 million in 2024). 5 share a federal owner or manager number with another hospice or home-health enrolment: A Plus Prime Care Hospice Inc with Merced Hospice Inc; Best Hospice Providers Inc with Best Home Health Providers, Inc.; Home Connect Hospice, LLC. (trading as Valor Hospice) with Wondrous Love Hospice Care LLC; Attaie Healthcare Inc with Attaie Healthcare Inc.  No two of the case hospices share a number with each other. None is on the federal revoked list.
how: The companies named as actors in the case file were looked up by name among Bay Area hospice enrolments. For each: certification date (federal Provider of Services file), incorporation date and present owners (federal owner file, latest quarter that lists the enrolment), every other hospice or home-health enrolment in California that ever carried one of the same federal owner or manager numbers, and any other licensed hospice or home-health agency at the same street address in the State listing. People are counted, not named. A negative number of months means the earliest present owner predates certification.
limits: A hospice and a home-health agency under one owner at one address is a common and permitted arrangement. An owner who arrived after certification may have bought a dormant licence, which was permitted before the rule the Federal Register notice describes, or may be a family member or new partner. Nothing here shows who was enrolled or what was billed.
